description: Step 1 of a readiness scan. Returns the domain-ownership token for the URL's host plus the three ways to publish it (DNS TXT record, <meta> tag, /.well-known file). The token is deterministic for the host, so calling this again returns the same value. Nothing is stored.

url.description: Public https URL of the SaaS signup (or landing) page, e.g. https://example.com/signup

name: readiness_get_verification_token
